Trust can lower friction in cooperation.

Preserved knowledge supports social continuity.
Documented observations can provide evidence.
Critical examination depends on relevant evidence.
Incomplete information limits warranted interpretations.
Satire is one social use of comedic presentation.
Platforms distribute shareable cultural material.

Memes can spread rapidly across networks.
Public derision can be directed toward a selected scapegoat.
Unequal power can create informal social rank.
